title: Lanterns of Bonk City
logline: Bonk City turns impact into glass: lanterns that show light without claiming to be it.
epigraph: A collision is only noise until someone names what it illuminated.
description: Chapter 6 of Lore.Land: Lanterns of Bonk City. Impact becomes civic light. Boof learns that a lantern is only glass — it shows the egg's heat, it is not the heat — while grains of the city sleep in the walls and wake when something strikes.

content.text: Boof stepped into Bonk City the way you step into a struck bell. The streets were a

children.text: of leaning glass. Every lantern turned toward the egg. The lanterns were not the light. They were glass: they showed the heat, they did not own it. In the walls, grains of the city slept — workers, watchers, names that could be woken, metered, shared, and put back to sleep. A collision somewhere upridge had just woken a streetful.

content.text: "In the labyrinth, the way forward is always through the glass," a voice said from the twisting paths. "Do not confuse the pane with the flame. The city offers light. The offering is not the cell."
"You’ve found my maze, Boof," the Fool’s voice teased from all directions, "but the real question is whether you can tell glass from heat when every street is leaning."

img.alt: Night streets: glass lanterns leaning toward a coal-warm cracked egg, the egg the true light.

sections.figcaption: Bonk City: a lantern is glass. The egg is the heat.

content.text: The city was alive in the way glass is alive when it holds a flame. No matter how far Boof walked, the lanterns rearranged around the egg. Each impact named a dent into light — spectacle with civic duty. She understood the offering: a place still worth finding after dark, proved by a pane that does not lie about being a pane.

content.text: Boof paused. "Is this part of the game?" The Fool's laughter came from behind a pane. "Perhaps the only way out," she mused, "is to stop asking the glass to be the fire." Ahead, a market stone waited with a groove for an oath and a price in fruit.

loreItems.description: Bonk City converts event energy into navigable light — spectacle with civic duty.
A lantern is glass. It shows heat; it is not the heat. The egg remains the cell.
Grains of the city sleep in the walls and wake when something strikes — rented, metered, shared, put back to sleep.
